svg.aria-label: Soft skills — How I work: Technical leadership: Guiding architecture decisions and the team that builds them. Mentoring: Helping other developers grow through reviews, pairing and feedback. Teamwork: Working closely with developers, design and product. Ownership: Taking work end to end, from the first commit to production. Client communication: Translating technical trade-offs into business terms. Problem solving: Diagnosing and fixing issues, even under pressure. Planning & estimation: Scoping work, budgets and timelines. Adaptability: Picking up new industries, stacks and teams quickly.
